sessions.today: Investigated why a contact ingested into CDP (EC 99d4176e…, TestLookalike BU 4_iWw03xI8s7jWHeAuswVMQQ, workspace 12207466, eu5-prod) never synced to Emarsys. Traced the full pipeline via cdp-kibana; the profile reached the CDFLDispatcher, resolved a valid ProfileSync vendor, then was dropped at message validation with 'Required properties are missing from object: businessAreas'. Corrected two of my own wrong diagnoses along the way (it was NOT a 'There is no action'/name-mismatch case — that log named a different app; and it was NOT a silent drop — the ERROR lived on the dispatcher pspanID, not the callID). Root cause: businessAreas is a required array<{BusinessArea:string}> on syncProfiles and the mapping didn't produce it. User found the fix I should have flagged first: map a plain STRING (the field holding the right business-area ID) into the array item — not an object, and not a StringToString default-if-empty (which can't build a row). Also observed a repeat ingest where the action had defaultMappings but no persisted custom mappings. Saved the case + reusable learning to the team KB (~/.cdp-investigate-knowledge).
